plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: The money ledger since the cutover of 2026-10-17 04:50-04:56 UTC (BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing in billing.env and live.env): deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy billing`, /opt/openvibe.billing, unit openvibe-billing, API on 127.0.0.1:4600 (loopback only; /api/v1 is denied on the public host). Public at https://billing.openvibe.network: the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS = the owner only), the billing policy (/policy), a person's own Vibes (/api/me/vibes, CORS for OpenVibe's sites), /api/health, /api/ready, /release.json and /webhooks/*. PowerChat deliveries reach /webhooks/powerchat through openvibe.live's /api/powerchat/webhook (proxied by Live's vhost, OpenVibe.Live#172).
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built, tested and deployed, with /metrics (loopback only), hourly scheduled reconciliation, EXTERNAL PowerChat receipts (billing.receipt.external, announced for OpenVibe.Tips), overflow guards and serializable settlement (PostgreSQL, ADR-035). The cutover (README runbook, docs/live-cutover.md) ran on 2026-10-17: final import 0 new rows, 0 holds, 0 anomalies; reconciliation OK before and after; Live's money tables are read-only behind a database tripwire. OpenVibe.Tips and OpenVibe.VIP launched right after (VIP checkout open). Still due: a small real PowerChat purchase settling end to end after the cutover. Live's payouts, refunds and plans have no tables of their own; where they map is docs/live-mapping.md.
features: append-only double-entry journal in bits and cents, balanced per currency
provider receipts stored before processing, settled once (PowerChat, Stripe, PayPal, CCBill, NOWPayments adapters)
intents, transfers, refunds, recycle, cashouts with escrow
subscriptions and entitlements
creator-priced subscription tiers, kept and charged by Billing (OpenVibe.VIP sets them)
renewal grace: a failed credit renewal is past_due for BILLING_RENEWAL_GRACE_DAYS (default 3) and retried on its key until grace_until, then expires with grace_ended; set 0 for immediate expiry
staff refund of a credit-paid subscription period (POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/refund) and reconciliation of every paid period against its charge (subscriptions.period_charged)
EXTERNAL PowerChat receipts (billing.receipt.external under BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing)
economy freeze
hourly reconciliation, ledger against receipts
staff console: cashouts, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log
public billing policy page
Live shadow import
openvibe-sdk/events outbox in service_outbox for billing.* events (legacy outbox retained for rollback)
per-person limits (openvibe-sdk/limits)
usage readings (billing.usage.record)

usage rating: a rate card -> the subject's promo allowance -> one usage transaction per reading, under hard budgets (BILLING_RATING_INTERVAL_MS off by default; nothing charged without a loaded card, key usage:<reading key>)
promo allowance ledger
a person's own Vibes for every site's account menu (/api/me/vibes)
network-wide money counts with no person in them, for products' public stats (billing.stats.read)
account export and deletion (ADR-033)
